comment: Config: resident model memory, 6000 MB VRAM budget, ReBAR direct uploads, vec4 GEMV + merged-KV shaders. The reference is stock llama.cpp Vulkan, which selects NV_coopmat2 matrix cores on this GPU; das's shaders are KHR-coopmat-class - a control build with coopmat2 disabled (GGML_VK_DISABLE_COOPMAT2=1) measured llama.cpp at 3790.9 pp512. Early numbers; the Vulkan lane is an active work area.
The decoder runs un-quantized fp32 - the token-parity configuration; long clips pay the most for it. Quantizing the decoder is open work.

On jfk.wav the reference's decode phase runs away (41.7 s of generation vs 30 ms on jfk3.wav; reproduced 3x with --temp 0 --reasoning off) - the two engines emit different amounts of text there, so that clip's ratio is a behavior difference, not a speed measurement.
